system.description: By using this power you may lay your hands on someone and stop her body from feeling any pain, or bring a vampire out of frenzy. This power also paralyzes the target for one turn per Mental Trait expended. You must defeat an unwilling target in a Physical Challenge. Improper use of this power (e.g., using it simply to paralyze a target) may demand a Beast Trait check. (This power is listed as an additional level-2 Obeah power in this supplement.)
system.duration: One turn per Mental Trait expended
